static_traits.name: Liu Zhicheng
static_traits.occupation: Full-time Real estate agent, part-time waiter
static_traits.family_status: Has 8 siblings and is the youngest; has a close circle of friends
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends, but has not yet shared this specific distress with them; avoids communicating with colleagues for fear of being judged
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological problems in the past; never received psychotherapy or counseling before; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-Reflect; neutral tone; catastrophic and absolutist statements in narration; Good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: When I have not received good tips as a part-time waiter, I develop Work-related feelings of worthlessness and despair.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thoughts and feelings (from not yet receiving good tips) are starting to affect my self-esteem and overall well-being, hence seeking counseling support.
growth_experiences: About a year ago experienced a particularly terrible Work night at the restaurant, not yet receiving good tips, since then repeatedly experiencing 'feelings of worthlessness and despair' in waiter Work scenes. At the time stress levels were high due to financial pressure and personal expectations. Since then the problem gradually escalated; each poor tip reinforces negative beliefs, recurring each shift (multiple times a week). During this time tried improving service, changing service style, even offering customers discounts to increase tips, but none worked.

special_situations.event: Not yet receiving good tips while on duty at the restaurant (e.g., last night)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If tips are not good, it means I am not approved by customers, proving I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries improving the service, changing the service style, and even offering customers discounts in the hope of raising tips
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never get good tips again

special_situations.event: As a newly appointed Elementary school teacher on the first day, errors in the lesson plan discovered by the principal
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make any mistake, I will be seen as incompetent and lose others' respect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently seeks comfort and reassurance from colleagues or superiors; avoids communicating with colleagues to reduce chances of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will eventually fail; everyone will think I am incompetent; I am a fraud

special_situations.event: Several classes actually went smoothly, with positive Student feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by being perfect, having no errors, can I count as capable and worthy of respect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive Self-monitoring, repeatedly checking errors; displacing attention from positive feedback to mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Just one small error proves I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Interaction situations where most colleagues give support and help
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' support is not reliable; they may just be polite, their real thoughts being dissatisfaction and criticism of me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance, reducing help-seeking to avoid exposing inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are actually scrutinizing me in secret, looking down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be respected and recognized, accepted as a capable and worthy person
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, humiliated or losing others' respect and connection
defense_goal: Avoiding being judged by pursuing perfection
Maintaining a sense of security through external reassurance
Stays distant to lower the chance of being hurt

object_relations.self_representation: A failure/impostor prone to feeling worthless and fearing scrutiny
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, picky others who will judge and negate me at any time (customers, principal, colleagues)

object_relations.self_representation: A beginner needing support, a colleague longing to be accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Supportive colleagues and friends willing to help

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When mistakes are pointed out (such as the principal discovering a lesson plan error) or when worried about others' evaluations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others are like harsh scrutinizers who will see me as incompetent (transference: internalizing past judgment and Projecting it onto current relationships)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'they look down on me' in a tense, defensive tone, avoiding directly discussing own feelings and needs, avoiding too many details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: After receiving a poor tip at the restaurant or a small mistake occurring in class
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning Sense of frustration that should be directed at external situations into negation of the self (I am incompetent)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using strong self-blaming statements (e.g., 'it is all my fault'), in a low tone, reducing interaction with others.

manifestations: Avoiding communication with colleagues for fear of being judged
Although having a close circle of friends, not yet sharing this specific distress
Feels scrutinized by others at work, difficult to build genuine connections
outcomes: Decline in work performance and Interpersonal avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently worries about making mistakes, treats small errors as proof of ability, and persistently blames oneself
Repeatedly emphasizing in sessions 'I will fail' 'I am a fraud'
Self-denial before seeking help, difficulty directly accessing support

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing colleagues and the principal are constantly scrutinizing and looking down on oneself
Interpreting tips from customers as judgments of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When invited to attend to positive classroom experiences, quickly turns back to mistakes and details that might go wrong
Hard to stay with positive experiences and support

exception_events.target_problem: In the new Teacher role, the client usually keeps worrying about making mistakes for fear of being judged, Avoiding communication with colleagues, and falling into Self-denial and Anxiety After a small mistake.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Several classes went smoothly, Student feedback positive, classroom atmosphere Good; compared with past worries, the teaching process that time was smoother with positive results.
exception_events.reason: Clues: positive Student responses and Good interaction appeared in class, bringing the client a different experience; this situation differed from past Anxiety-dominated moments.

positive_force: Having a supportive circle of friends
At work, continuously trying to improve service and strategy (improving service, changing approaches, offering discounts)
Capable of sustained Work (full-time Real estate agent, part-time waiter)
negative_force: Cognitive biases of catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mind-reading and predicting the future
Binding external evaluations (tips, others' gazes) strongly to self-worth, relying excessively on external validation
Perfectionism and rigid 'should' standards: believing one must not make mistakes to deserve respect
Avoiding communication with colleagues, not yet expressing distress to friends, so the support system is not yet effectively used
Sleep affected and Low mood, further impairing Work performance and Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Strong feelings of worthlessness and despair from poor tips in waiter Work
antecedent: Not yet receiving good tips while Working at the restaurant
target_behavior.core_reason: Financial pressure and a high level of personal expectations, directly equating customers' tips with one's own value (catastrophizing and overgeneralization).
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the pain of being negated and uncertainty, maintaining control in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Low mood and insomnia, affecting daily life and Work performance.

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Fear of making mistakes in the Teacher role and Avoiding communication with colleagues
antecedent: Being told by the principal about errors in the lesson plan
Thinking about possibly making mistakes again
Needing to interact with or seek help from colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged as incompetent, holding the perfectionist standard of 'must not make mistakes' and cognitive biases of mind-reading / predicting the future.
target_behavior.function: Gains short-term security through avoiding interaction, reducing the possibility of exposure and judgment.
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal isolation, Anxiety maintained, Learning and collaboration at Work hindered; needing frequent reassurance.

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeking others' reassurance to ease Anxiety
antecedent: When worrying others will think one incompetent
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly relies on external validation to confirm self-worth and security, with insufficient internal Self-efficacy.
target_behavior.function: Gaining short-term comfort and Anxiety relief.
target_behavior.consequence: Increased dependence on external sources; long-term Anxiety and negative beliefs not yet improved.
